title: Release tooling keeps the desktop minimum version lock: carried by prepare, re-checked by publish, changed and resumed by set-minimum
steps: S1: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/release-feed.test.mjs (channelYml, readPolicy, comparePolicy, withPolicy).
S2: Run node --test on packages/desktop/tracy-desktop/test/release.test.mjs (prepare / publish / set-minimum over a folder store).
expect: S1: a policy is three top-level lines inside the signed channel file; none writes no line (old files byte-identical); a minimum above the offered version, a dev minimum on stable, a date without timezone or without a minimum, a revision that is missing, not whole or <= 0 are refused; withPolicy refuses a lower revision (replay).

S2: prepare with no flag carries the feed policy at the same revision and records policy/revision/ETag per channel file; a change without --min-version-reason, a loosening without --lower-min-version and an earlier start without a reason stop before building; publish refuses a candidate prepared before the policy was raised, lowered or the file only rewritten, and no flag (not --waive) passes; set-minimum stopped between a .yml and its .sig is refused without --resume and finished by --resume with all four files verifying under the pinned key; a replayed older policy is refused.
fence: publish compares every channel file under the publish lock with the policy prepare read (ETag + policy) and refuses on any difference; set-minimum writes only under the same lock and never a revision older than one a file carries

tests: a policy is three top-level lines after the build id
a policy the channel file cannot carry is refused
a channel file with no policy carries no policy line
a policy older than the one a channel file carries is never written over it (replay)
prepare with no policy flag carries the feed policy over
a policy change without its reason, or a loosening without --lower-min-version, stops before building
a candidate prepared before the feed policy changed is refused at publish
set-minimum stopped between a channel file and its signature is finished by --resume
--resume never writes a policy older than one a channel file already carries (replay)
a candidate prepared before a set-minimum is refused at publish
